text:
Maria (DevEx): hey team — opened a small PR to update the Python quickstart + curl example in the SDK docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. can someone take a quick look? main asks: clarify auth env var name, add a minimal streaming snippet, and ensure the curl example includes correct headers. not urgent but hoping for approvals before EOD PST.

Sam: I can take a pass around noon PT. do you have a runnable streaming snippet? i might try it locally.

Alex: left a few inline comments, mostly nits. main things: prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY vs API_KEY (avoid collision), call out token scopes briefly, and the curl example needs Content-Type: application/json. posted review comments: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823/files

Maria (DevEx): thanks Alex — i'll push a patch in ~30m. streaming snippet i tossed in for now:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()  # picks up REDWOOD_API_KEY from env
for chunk in client.stream("Generate a short greeting"):
    print(chunk)
```
super minimal, open to wording + error handling suggestions.

Joel: quick question — will this rename break any existing quickstarts or guides? if so we should add a migration note.

Maria (DevEx): good call. this is docs-only rename of the env var in examples; adding a short migration note and search/replace checklist. no runtime change.

Sam: saw the follow-up commit — LGTM after i fixed one grammar nit (pushed directly). if Alex + Joel approve we can merge once CI green.

Alex: approved. one tiny wording tweak pushed. :thumbsup:

Sam: merging after CI checks pass (docs lint + link check).

docs-ci-bot: docs checks passed — link-check ok, spelling warnings: 0.

Maria (DevEx): thanks all! leaving a tiny changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md and a note in the quickstart that REDWOOD_API_KEY is the recommended env var. appreciate the fast reviews.
